examples.note: Laayoune — the 0528 prefix serves the southern provinces including Western Sahara
Mobile — Moroccan mobile ranges apply throughout the territory

notes: Western Sahara has no separate country code. The territory is administered by Morocco for telecommunications purposes and falls entirely within the +212 numbering plan.
The 0528 prefix covers the southern provinces including Laayoune and Dakhla.
The territory's political status is disputed; this entry reflects the numbering arrangement in operational use, not a position on sovereignty.
sources: ANRT — Agence Nationale de Réglementation des Télécommunications: https://www.anrt.ma/
